item.tib: sems can mgu bar bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa
item.skt: sat+wa ra d+ha n+ya gA thA
item.coloph: sems can mgu bar bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gcig pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis phyung ba rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po bud+d+ha ka ra varma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
